analysis.visual_description: The same tables on the bed. The three short lines are in. The rest of the leaf stays pale. He reads them and does not add a fourth. No face.
The stylus lies in the gutter of the tables. No sum. No hour. No title under the three lines. No face.
A thumb on the cover, not yet closed. The grey cloak is still on the peg by the door. No face.
